purpose: Diagnose whether fixed slow components mask repeated image alignment, and whether adjusted post-event alignment exceeds its pre-event counterpart. Preserve all original R/G/T estimates, thresholds and protected roles.
selection_history: One fixed degree-three follow-up selected after the completed all30 diagnostic: mean nuisance polynomial error fraction 0.8171545150823637; raw matched-minus-shift37 cosine 0.01681012873754902 with interval crossing zero. Degree, windows and cyclic shift are fixed before this follow-up's outcomes; no cutoff, degree, channel, lag-peak or participant search.
interpretation: Positive adjusted alignment and a positive paired raw-to-adjusted change would weaken inability to recover repeated image structure; positive adjusted post-minus-pre alignment would weaken a slow/order explanation. Whole-sequence noncausal projection and overlapping image responses still limit causation. Uncertain or negative estimates do not establish signal absence or clear the original failed controls.
